name: Write the regex
description: Write a regular expression. Visible tests light up as you type; hidden tests are checked by the grader. Partial credit by the share of tests right.

fields.name: match
fields.label: Should match
fields.description: Visible strings the pattern must match.

fields.name: reject
fields.label: Should not match
fields.description: Visible strings the pattern must not match.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Hidden tests: { "match": [...], "reject": [...] }, checked only when grading.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: "full": the whole string must match (the pattern is wrapped in ^(?:…)$). "find": a match anywhere counts.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Starting flags (any of i, m, s, u). The learner can change them.

fields.name: solution
fields.description: One correct pattern, shown after grading.
